title: The Tattooist of Auschwitz
author: Heather Morris
summary: A Slovak Jewish man is forced to tattoo numbers onto fellow prisoners at Auschwitz. He falls in love with a young woman he marks and risks his life to help others survive.
readIf: you want a very readable, emotional entry point into Holocaust fiction.
skipIf: you want strict historical accuracy; it is a novel drawn from one man's account, and historians have raised questions about details.

pairings.reason: Another accessible war-time story told with great tenderness, focused on small acts of kindness under terror.
Also centres on the courage of ordinary people in occupied Europe, with a stronger focus on women.
A shorter, simpler fable about the camps seen through a child's eyes.
